Preprocess and Select Highly Variable Genes for Trajectory Evaluation (Saelens et al., 2019)

Source: R/06_metrics_trajectory.R
preprocess_trajectory_hvgs.Rd

Implements the standardized scRNA-seq quality control and HVG selection workflow from the dynverse benchmarking study (Saelens et al., Nature Biotechnology, 2019):

  1. Harsh cell outlier filtering (3 MADs from median on library size, detected genes, and mitochondrial percentage).

  2. Low-expression gene filtering (expressed in \(\ge 5\%\) of cells and average expression \(> 0.02\)).

  3. HVG selection via mean-variance decomposition (scran::modelGeneVar with FDR < 0.05 and biological variance > 0.5, with adaptive top-HVG fallback for sparse/small benchmark sets).

  4. Iterative removal of all-zero cells and uninformative zero features until convergence.

Usage

preprocess_trajectory_hvgs(
  ref_data,
  sim_data = NULL,
  cell_types_ref = NULL,
  cell_types_sim = NULL,
  nmads = 3,
  min_cell_frac = 0.05,
  min_mean_expr = 0.02,
  fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  bio_var_threshold = 0.5,
  min_hvgs = 30L,
  max_hvgs = 1500L
)

Arguments

ref_data

Reference count matrix, SingleCellExperiment, or Seurat object.

sim_data

Optional simulated count matrix, SingleCellExperiment, or Seurat object.

cell_types_ref

Optional vector of reference cell-type labels.

cell_types_sim

Optional vector of simulated cell-type labels.

nmads

MAD threshold for outlier cell removal (default 3).

min_cell_frac

Minimum fraction of cells expressing a retained gene (default 0.05).

min_mean_expr

Minimum average expression count for a retained gene (default 0.02).

fdr_threshold

FDR cutoff for HVG biological variance (default 0.05).

bio_var_threshold

Minimum biological variance component for strict HVG selection (default 0.5).

min_hvgs

Minimum HVG floor with adaptive fallback if fewer pass strict thresholds (default 30L).

max_hvgs

Maximum HVG cap for tractable Random Forest importance fitting (default 1500L).

Value

A list containing HVG-filtered log-normalized expression matrices (ref_expr, sim_expr), selected HVG names (hvgs), synced cell-type vectors (cell_types_ref, cell_types_sim), HVG statistics table (hvg_stats), and filtering counts (summary).

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
prep <- preprocess_trajectory_hvgs(example_scrna$ref, example_scrna$sim,
  cell_types_ref = example_scrna$cell_types, cell_types_sim = example_scrna$cell_types)
length(prep$hvgs)
#> [1] 60
